subject: RM_Surrik

reply.subject: RM_Surrik

observed.facings.png: Three views at one shared scale on a checkerboard. South: a wide, dome-shaped grey-brown bulk lying flat, a blunt rounded head merging into massive shoulders, a horizontal slit across the top of the head, two small dark wide-set eyes, a pale creased throat and belly, and two flipper stubs splayed out flat to the sides. East: a long, low profile with the body sloping from a high shoulder hump down to a tapering tail point on the left, a flipper stub under the chest, and a blunt squared head on the right with a small eye and a mouth slit along the upper snout that opens upward. North: the rear of the same dome, with splayed flippers, a pale underside showing at the base and a short pointed tail at bottom centre. No face or eyes.
observed.south.png: Front view at full resolution. Matte, finely wrinkled slate-brown hide with a pale cream underside and chin folds. The eyes are small and dark, set wide on a broad flat face. The upper surface carries a horizontal slit with a lip. The lower face has a downturned fold that reads a little like a frown. Flippers are flat on the ground. The background is clean transparent, with no shadow.
observed.east.png: Side profile. The body hunkers flat on the ground. The highest mass is the shoulder hump behind the head, which tapers to a pointed tail. The head is blunt with no neck. The mouth slit runs along the top of the snout and curls upward at the front. A small dark eye sits behind it. The pale underside runs along the belly, and one fore-flipper stub sits under the chest. The background is transparent.
observed.north.png: Rear view. A broad wrinkled back with a ridge, two side flippers and a central pointed tail tip touching the ground, with the pale belly visible at the bottom edges. No eyes and no face. The background is transparent.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the surrik lies beside the vanilla human. It is about one cell long and lower than the human's waist, a low grey-brown seal-like body. At 32 px/cell it shows as a small grey-brown elongated shape beside the human and the rat, low contrast against the brown ground but distinguishable.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the face head-on: two eyes, the top slit and the chin folds, with flippers spread symmetrically.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the back, the ridge and a pointed tail tip. No eyes or face.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three are the angled game camera: the dome is seen from the front or rear and east is a true profile. None is a plan view.

SAME_SIZE.seen: The 19% spread comes from the pose. East is a long, low profile (118 px), while south and north look along the body's tall axis at the shoulder dome (136/140). Widths and bulk match across the views.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: Palette, hide texture, pale underside, flipper stubs and tail are consistent. The flippers splay sideways on south and north and sit under the chest in profile on east.

SIGNATURE.seen: It reads as a heavy, low burrow-swimmer hunkered on the ground with an upward mouth slit, which fits 'shouldering through the mat' and 'takes from underneath'.

ALIEN.seen: The seal-like bulk is required by the brief. The neckless shoulder-dome, the upward slit mouth on top of the head and the wedge-shaped body depart from any real seal. All the departures are present.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1: Present. It rests flat on the ground with no terrain, crust, wake or roots painted. 2: Present. Massive shoulders are the highest mass and the blunt head sits on them with no neck (east). 3: Present. Matte slate-brown hide, pale underside, small wide-set dark eyes and flipper stubs, with no claws or digging paws. 4: Present. The slit sits along the top of the snout and opens upward (east profile, the top slit on south).

STYLE.seen: Painterly and realistic, with fine wrinkle texture, matte shading and a thin dark edge. The south face's downturned chin fold reads slightly expressive but not cartoonish.

OURS.seen: A bespoke invented creature that matches no vanilla or known mod animal.

ALPHA.seen: Clean transparency on all facings. No ground patch, shadow or halo.

SCALE.seen: About one cell long and lower than the human's waist. The description gives no size words and drawSize is 1.0, so this is plausible for a mid-sized burrower.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it reads as a low elongated grey-brown body that stands apart from the brown ground, though the contrast is modest.

reply.image_seen: The facing sheet and individual sprites show a brown, ground-resting creature: south has small eyes and an upper mouth slit, east has broad shoulders and a blunt head, north shows back and tail; the scale panel places it beside a human.

subject: RM_TruffleMole

reply.subject: RM_TruffleMole

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale. South: a stocky, shaggy brown creature seen head-on. It has a pink pig snout disc, pink pig ears, small dark eyes, and two big pink forepaws with long curved digging claws spread in front. East: a long, low side profile with a barrel trunk, a pig head and snout disc, and clawed forepaws reaching forward. The hind legs are short and the tail is a thin pink pig tail. North: the rear, with a broad furry back, a pink curled tail, two hind feet, and the forepaws with claws sticking out sideways. The ear tips show at the top. No face. The north body stands a little more upright and taller than the south crouch.
observed.south.png: Front view, face toward the camera. The pig rooting disc with two large nostrils sits in the middle of the face. Small eyes, pink pointed ears, a dense bristly coat, and mole-like spade forepaws with long pale claws. Clean alpha, no ground.
observed.east.png: True side profile facing right. Low, elongated pig-like body, hunched. The snout disc points forward. The forepaw has long claws. Short hind legs, thin pink tail. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view: back, rump, a short curled pink tail, and the soles of the hind feet. Forepaws stick out to both sides with claws, and the ear tips are visible. No eyes or face. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom it is about as long as a human is tall: roughly 1.5 cells long and about 0.8 cells tall. At 32 px per cell it reads as a small brown pig-shaped animal with a pink snout, next to the human.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: The south view shows the face head-on: snout disc, both eyes, both ears, forepaws in front.

NORTH_REAR.seen: The north view shows the back, rump, tail and hind feet. No face or eyes; only the ear tips show at the top.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three views are at the game's angled camera; none is overhead.

SAME_SIZE.seen: East is 137 px tall against 197 and 213 px for south and north, but east is a long, low profile that is much wider than the end-on views, so the gap is the pose. The body bulk looks comparable across all three. North stands slightly taller than south, which is minor.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The brown bristly coat, pink snout, pink ears, clawed forepaws and pink tail appear in every view where they should, with a consistent palette.

SIGNATURE.seen: The defining smell organ, a large pig rooting snout with prominent nostrils, is the focal point of the south and east views.

ALIEN.seen: The pig head is intended by the description, which ties it to truffle pigs. The oversized mole digging claws on spade forepaws, the low hunched digging body and the dense mole-like coat make it a chimera, not a plain Earth pig.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1) A flat pig rooting disc instead of a pointed mole nose: present. 2) Oversized nostrils dominating the face: largely present; the disc and nostrils are large and central, though they are ordinary pig nostrils rather than 'elaborate'. 3) Pig and mole mixed in one body: present, with a stocky pig trunk, pig ears and tail, and mole spade claws on the forelimbs.

STYLE.seen: Painterly, finely rendered fur and skin, a realistic face, not cute, with a thin dark edge. Not cel-shaded or a 3D render.

OURS.seen: Bespoke art matching the brief; not a vanilla pig or other donor art.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on the checkerboard in every view. No ground patch or shadow.

SCALE.seen: About human-length, a stocky mid-sized animal. The description gives no size words, so this is plausible.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it reads as a brown body with a pink snout, distinct from the ground, though it reads mainly as 'pig'.

findings.seen: The nostrils are large, but they are ordinary pig nostrils on a pig disc, not an elaborate or specialised smell organ.

findings.seen: The head, with its pink ears, eyes and snout, is essentially a domestic pig's head. At 32 px the animal reads as a hairy pig, though the claws and posture are mole-like.

findings.fix: Make the head more mole-like around the pig disc: smaller or hidden ears, tinier eyes sunk in fur, and a broader head flowing into the shoulders, so the creature reads as a pig–mole hybrid at a glance.

reply.subject: RM_TruffleMole
reply.image_seen: The composite and individual sprites show a brown, stocky pig–mole creature: south has enormous folded nostrils and digging claws, east shows its long trunk and rooting snout, north shows its back, tail and haunches; the scale panel places it beside a human and rat.

concerns.evidence: In south, two tall nostril cavities with thick, ribbed pink rims occupy most of the muzzle, extending from below the eyes nearly to the chin. East preserves the projecting disc and deeply folded nostril opening. Their exaggerated size and elaborate fleshy folds visibly establish the specialized smell organ.

North's 213 px versus south's 197 px reflects its extended hind legs and raised ear tips, while south crouches behind its forward-reaching digging paws. The flagged 56% spread includes east's 137 px silhouette: the elongated trunk runs horizontally in profile, whereas front and rear project the rounded back above the head or haunches. The shared-scale panel shows comparable trunk bulk, snout size and claw size, without a convincing overall scale jump.

reasons: opus band WEAK (model said good); blocking ['DEPARTURE_MISSING', 'F_SIZE_JUMP']; polish ['STYLE_EARTHLY']
